mapper.select:
SELECT T2.TYPE_9, T2.TYPE_10, T2.TYPE_11 FROM FIN_PRODUCT T1 LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE T2 ON T1.FINPROD_ID = T2.FINPROD_ID
AND T1.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

select distinct result.workflowId,result.pageId from (select n.seq_no workflowId, l.page_id pageId, n.update_time updateDate from sys_wfl_business_node n,sys_wfl_business_list l where 1=1 and n.hi_user != nvl(l.next_user,' ') and l.BUSINESS_TYPE in (select c.menu_id from Tm_App_Audit_Type_Confit c) and n.seq_no = l.seq_no
and n.hi_user = #{userId} and IFNULL(l.next_user,' ') not like '${userId},%' and IFNULL(l.next_user,' ') not like '%,${userId}' and IFNULL(l.next_user,' ') not like '%,${userId},%'
order by n.create_time desc) result

select USER_ID as userId, SYSTEM_CODE as systemCode, USER_NAME as userName, REAL_NAME as realName, MAIL_ADDR as mailAddr, PHONE_NUM as phoneNum, PASSWORD as password, SALT as salt, DEPT_CODE as deptCode, SSO_USER_ID as ssoUserId, ADMIN_FLAG as adminFlag, IS_FROZEN as isFrozen, WECHAT_NUM as wechatNum from SYS_USER where USER_NAME = #{userName, jdbcType=VARCHAR}
SELECT SEQ_NO as seqNo, FILE_NAME as fileName, PATH as "path", BUSINESS_ID as businessId FROM SYS_UPLOAD_FILE_INFO where SEQ_NO = #{fileNo,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

select aa.menu_id menuId, aa.remark menuName from (select * from sys_menu m start with m.menu_id in (select pa.menu_id from sys_menu pa where pa.page_id = #{pageid, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) connect by prior m.parent_menu_id = m.menu_id) aa where aa.parent_menu_id is null
SELECT COUNTER_NAME FROM MST_COUNTER_PARTY WHERE COUNTER_ID = #{counterId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}
SELECT CALENDAR_NAME FROM MST_CALENDAR_INFO WHERE CALENDAR_ID = #{calendarId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}
SELECT SEC_ACCT_NAME FROM STL_SEC_ACCT_INFO WHERE SEC_ACCT_ID = #{secacctid, jdbcType=VARCHAR}
SELECT customer_name FROM MST_CUSTOMER_INFO where customer_id= #{customerId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}
SELECT COUNTER_NAME FROM MST_COUNTER_PARTY where COUNTER_ID= #{counterId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}

SELECT NVL(A.FINPROD_ABBR, A.FINPROD_NAME) text FROM FIN_PRODUCT A LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_ADD B ON A.FINPROD_ID = B.FINPROD_ID WHERE A.IS_CHL = 'Y' AND A.FINPROD_TYPE2 = 'F28' AND A.FINPROD_ID = #{chlId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}
SELECT PT.PORTFOLIO_NAME TEXT FROM PTL_PORTFOLIO PT WHERE PT.PORTFOLIO_ID = #{portfolioId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}

with tempce as (select m.seqno as creditMstId,m.CREDIT_QUOTE_TYPE_VALUE as creditQuoteTypeCode ,y.item_value as creditQuoteTypeValue, DECODE(trim(n.linked_item_code), ' ', 'root', trim(n.linked_item_code)) AS upperCreditQuoteTypeCode from CREDIT_MST_INFO m inner JOIN SYS_DATADICT_LIST_LINK n ON m.CREDIT_QUOTE_TYPE_VALUE = n.item_code and m.CREDIT_QUOTE_TYPE_CODE=n.dict_code left join SYS_DATADICT_LIST y ON m.CREDIT_QUOTE_TYPE_VALUE = y.item_code and m.CREDIT_QUOTE_TYPE_CODE=y.dict_code where M.CREDIT_INFO_TYPE = '04' AND (m.CREDIT_QUOTE_RANK <> #{rank,jdbcType=VARCHAR} or m.CREDIT_QUOTE_RANK is null) union ALL select m.seqno as creditMstId,m.CREDIT_QUOTE_TYPE_VALUE as creditQuoteTypeCode ,y.item_value as creditQuoteTypeValue,'root' AS upperCreditQuoteTypeCode from CREDIT_MST_INFO m left join SYS_DATADICT_LIST y ON m.CREDIT_QUOTE_TYPE_VALUE = y.item_code and m.CREDIT_QUOTE_TYPE_CODE=y.dict_code where M.CREDIT_INFO_TYPE = '04' AND m.CREDIT_QUOTE_RANK =#{rank,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ) select A.creditMstId,A.creditQuoteTypeCode,A.creditQuoteTypeValue,A.upperCreditQuoteTypeCode,(case when count(B.creditQuoteTypeCode) > 0 then '02' else '01' end) as hasChildren ,null as creditAmt from tempce A left join tempce B on A.creditQuoteTypeCode=B.upperCreditQuoteTypeCode GROUP BY A.creditMstId,A.creditQuoteTypeCode,A.creditQuoteTypeValue,A.upperCreditQuoteTypeCode order by creditMstId asc,upperCreditQuoteTypeCode
select tm.id id, tm.business_type businessType, tm.tab_Name tabName, tm.tab_Id tabId, tm.TM_EFFECTFLAG tmEffectflag from Tm_App_Audit_Tab_Confit tm
mapper.insert: insert into TM_APP_TOKEN(USERID, TOKEN , Expiration_data, create_data) values(#{userId}, #{token},SYSDATE+15,SYSDATE)

SELECT ITEM_VALUE FROM CREDIT_MST_INFO cmi left join SYS_DATADICT_LIST sdl ON cmi.CREDIT_QUOTE_TYPE_VALUE = sdl.item_code and cmi.CREDIT_QUOTE_TYPE_CODE=sdl.dict_code where 1=1
AND cmi.SEQNO = #{creditMstId}

SELECT B.FINPROD_MARKET_ID finprodMarketId, B.FINPROD_ABBR finprodAbbr, A.PLEDGE_FACE_VALUE*A.PLEDGE_NUMBER qty, A.PLEDGE_RATIO*100 pledgeRatio, A.PLEDGE_FINPROD_ID, A.PLEDGE_NUMBER FROM FIN_DEAL_PLEDGE A LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT B ON A.PLEDGE_FINPROD_ID = B.FINPROD_ID WHERE A.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId}

SELECT PAGE_ID FROM SYS_WFL_BUSINESS_LIST WHERE 1=1
AND SEQ_NO = #{workflowId}

SELECT ACTION_TYPE FROM SYS_WFL_BUSINESS_LIST WHERE 1=1
AND SEQ_NO = #{workflowId}

SELECT T2.ID_ taskId, T2.PROC_INST_ID_ workflowId, T2.ASSIGNEE_ hiUser, T2.TASK_DEF_KEY_ nodeId, T2.NAME_ nodeName, DECODE(T1.MESSAGE_,'无',null,T1.MESSAGE_) "comment", NVL(T2.END_TIME_,T2.CLAIM_TIME_) operTime FROM ACT_HI_TASKINST T2 LEFT JOIN ACT_HI_COMMENT T1 ON T1.TASK_ID_=T2.ID_ AND T1.PROC_INST_ID_=T2.PROC_INST_ID_ AND T1.USER_ID_=T2.ASSIGNEE_ WHERE T2.PROC_INST_ID_=#{workflowId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ORDER BY T2.PROC_INST_ID_, IFNULL(T2.END_TIME_, DATE_FORMAT('2099-12-31 23:59:59', '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s')) ASC

SELECT WORKFLOW_ID FROM SYS_WFL_BUSINESS_LIST WHERE 1=1
AND SEQ_NO = #{workflowId}
